name: abxag
description: ABxAG — a private 3D AI desktop companion powered by each user's own Gemini API key.
author: ABxAG

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:launcher && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:public: set VITE_ABxAG_PUBLIC=1&& npm run build && npm run build:launcher && electron-builder --config electron-builder.public.yml --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.yml --linux AppImage -p never
scripts.test:agent: node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/models.test.ts tests/agentLoop.test.ts tests/presence.test.ts tests/chatOpen.test.ts tests/taskResultText.test.ts tests/updaterInstall.test.ts tests/characterVoice.test.ts tests/stageCommand.test.ts tests/outfitTint.test.ts tests/companionCommands.test.ts tests/commandPalette.test.ts tests/cyberpunk.test.ts tests/overlaySettings.test.ts tests/hudHologram.test.ts tests/alarms.test.ts tests/alarmWatchdog.test.ts tests/agentBundle.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:agent && npm run test:characters && npm run test:python
